title: Fix fumadocs documentation links and add automated link checking with path remapping
body:
## ✅ Task Complete: Fixed All Fumadocs Link Errors + Added Link Checking

### Changes Made
- [x] Scan all MDX files and identify link patterns
- [x] Fix broken tutorial links (redirect to actual documentation or examples)
- [x] Fix broken FAQ and troubleshooting links (correct paths)
- [x] Convert ALL links (both markdown and JSX) to absolute /docs/ paths
- [x] Fix /examples/ links to use GitHub URLs
- [x] Fix tutorial links to point to existing reference pages
- [x] Fix redundant /content/docs prefixes
- [x] Verify all internal links are working
- [x] Test documentation build
- [x] Add automated link checking with GitHub Actions
- [x] Fix workflow action versions (use stable tags)
- [x] Configure path remapping for internal link validation
- [x] Fix lychee.toml TOML syntax error

### Summary
- **Files Modified**: 51 MDX files + 3 config files (workflow + lychee.toml + .lycheeignore)
- **All Links**: Converted to absolute `/docs/` paths (279 conversions)
- **Build Status**: ✅ Successful (618 pages generated)
- **CI Status**: ✅ Fixed - lychee.toml syntax corrected

### Automated Link Checking Features

#### Lychee Configuration (`lychee.toml`)
**FIXED**: Corrected TOML syntax for remap configuration
- ✅ **Path Remapping**: Uses correct syntax `"^/docs/(.*)$ content/docs/$1.mdx"`
- ✅ Validates internal Fumadocs routes against actual file system paths
- ✅ No running server required for internal link validation
- ✅ Supports both `.md` and `.mdx` file extensions
- ✅ Configurable timeout (30s), retries (2), and concurrency (10)
- ✅ Caching enabled for faster subsequent runs
- ✅ Verbose logging for detailed diagnostics

#### GitHub Action Workflow (`.github/workflows/check-links.yml`)
- ✅ Triggers on push to main and pull requests
- ✅ Scans all `.md` and `.mdx` files in `content/` directory + `README.md`
- ✅ Uses lychee-action@v2 with custom `lychee.toml` configuration
- ✅ **Validates internal `/docs/*` links** via path remapping (no server needed!)
- ✅ **Validates external links** (GitHub, Discord, documentation sites, etc.)
- ✅ Fails CI if broken links detected (blocks merge)
- ✅ Creates GitHub issue on failure for tracking
  
#### Ignore Rules (`.lycheeignore`)
- Localhost links (`http://localhost*`)
- Example links (`https://example.com`)
- Social media (`https://twitter.com*`, `https://x.com*`) - prevents anti-bot false positives
- Mailto links

**Fix Applied**: Changed from incorrect `[[remap]]` table syntax to correct array of strings format: `remap = ["pattern replacement", ...]`
